title: Bank Analytics Dashboard
tagline: End-to-end banking data analysis with fraud detection
overview: Analyzed 1M+ bank transactions to identify fraud patterns, customer behavior, and branch performance. Built interactive Power BI dashboard for executive reporting.
objectives: Analyze customer segmentation by account type
key_insights: 78% of fraud transactions occurred in amounts between ₹45,000-₹1,25,000
New accounts (< 6 months) show 3x higher fraud probability
Metro branches handle 65% of total transaction volume
Loan default rate highest in Q3 (monsoon season)
github_description: Banking analytics project with fraud detection
